content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the legacy flow table attempting to allocate a new 4M entry table when enabling SR-IOV after adding a TC NIC rule, which exceeded the available flow table entries. This occurred because the legacy flow table did not properly account for the already allocated flow tables in the system, leading to a failure in enabling SR-IOV. The fix involved modifying the allocation logic to use the next available maximum size from the flow table pool, preventing the allocation failure.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the legacy flow table attempting to allocate a new 4M entry table when enabling SR-IOV after adding a TC NIC rule, which exceeded the available flow table entries. This occurred because the legacy flow table did not properly account for the already allocated flow tables in the system, leading to a failure in enabling SR-IOV. The fix involved modifying the allocation logic to use the next available maximum size from the flow table pool, preventing the allocation failure.
Patch:
From 0c9d876545a56aebed30fa306d0460a4d28d271a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Paul Blakey <paulb@nvidia.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jun 2022 13:11:18 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] net/mlx5e: Fix enabling sriov while tc nic rules are
 offloaded

There is a total of four 4M entries flow tables. In sriov disabled
mode, ct, ct_nat and post_act take three of them. When adding the
first tc nic rule in this mode, it will take another 4M table
for the tc <chain,prio> table. If user then enables sriov, the legacy
flow table tries to take another 4M and fails, and so enablement fails.

To fix that, have legacy fdb take the next available maximum
size from the fs ft pool.

Fixes: 4a98544d1827 ("net/mlx5: Move chains ft pool to be used by all firmware steering")
Signed-off-by: Paul Blakey <paulb@nvidia.com>
Reviewed-by: Roi Dayan <roid@nvidia.com>
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@nvidia.com>
---
 drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/esw/legacy.c | 5 +++--
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/esw/legacy.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/esw/legacy.c
index 9d17206d1625..fabe49a35a5c 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/esw/legacy.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/esw/legacy.c
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@
 #include "mlx5_core.h"
 #include "eswitch.h"
 #include "fs_core.h"
+#include "fs_ft_pool.h"
 #include "esw/qos.h"
 
 enum {
@@ -95,8 +96,7 @@ static int esw_create_legacy_fdb_table(struct mlx5_eswitch *esw)
 	if (!flow_group_in)
 		return -ENOMEM;
 
-	table_size = BIT(MLX5_CAP_ESW_FLOWTABLE_FDB(dev, log_max_ft_size));
-	ft_attr.max_fte = table_size;
+	ft_attr.max_fte = POOL_NEXT_SIZE;
 	ft_attr.prio = LEGACY_FDB_PRIO;
 	fdb = mlx5_create_flow_table(root_ns, &ft_attr);
 	if (IS_ERR(fdb)) {
@@ -105,6 +105,7 @@ static int esw_create_legacy_fdb_table(struct mlx5_eswitch *esw)
 		goto out;
 	}
 	esw->fdb_table.legacy.fdb = fdb;
+	table_size = fdb->max_fte;
 
 	/* Addresses group : Full match unicast/multicast addresses */
 	MLX5_SET(create_flow_group_in, flow_group_in, match_criteria_enable,
-- 
2.25.1
